# Generated by tools/build_mod.py. Country scope except state-targeted actions.
# Explicit opt-in on both new campaigns and existing saves. Approved actions only.
sed_enable_country = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_schema_version } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_schema_version value = 1 }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_enabled value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_monthly_refresh value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_iron_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_coal_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_tools_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_groceries_action_status value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_clothes_action_status value = 0 }
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual has_variable = sed_mode_assisted has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } }
  sed_set_mode_assisted = yes
 }
 sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
 sed_ensure_journal_entry = yes
}

sed_ensure_journal_entry = {
 if = {
  limit = {
   has_variable = sed_enabled
   NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_sed_diagnostics }
   NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_sed_diagnostics }
  }
  add_journal_entry = { type = je_sed_diagnostics }
 }
}

sed_monthly_update = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_ensure_journal_entry = yes
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_monthly_refresh }
   sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_refresh_national_plan = yes sed_coord_sync = yes }
  sed_schedule_auto_event = yes
 }
}

sed_refresh_diagnostics = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  sed_ensure_mode_default = yes
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_balance value = net_total_income }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_operating_balance value = net_fixed_income }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_fixed_expenses value = fixed_expenses }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/war_support_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_gold value = gold_reserves }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_debt value = principal }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_credit value = credit }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/ip5_je_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_gdp value = gdp }
 # vanilla/common/script_values/ip5_je_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_population value = total_population }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_economy_health_effects.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_sol value = average_sol }
 # vanilla/common/journal_entries/00_sick_man.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_literacy value = literacy_rate }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction value = modifier:country_construction_add }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_public_projects value = num_queued_government_constructions }
 # Economy Advisor/advisor_core_values.txt
 set_variable = { name = sed_private_projects value = num_queued_private_constructions }
  set_variable = { name = sed_last_year value = year }
  # The game's month trigger is zero-based (vanilla ip4_custom_loc.txt).
  set_variable = { name = sed_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_month_key value = { value = year multiply = 12 add = month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_in_default value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_in_default value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_gdp_per_capita value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_per_capita_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_population > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gdp_per_capita value = { value = var:sed_gdp divide = var:sed_population } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_per_capita_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_credit > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share value = { value = var:sed_debt divide = var:sed_credit } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_debt_share_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks_available value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:sed_balance < 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks value = { value = var:sed_gold min = 0 divide = { value = var:sed_balance multiply = -1 } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_reserve_weeks_available value = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_infrastructure_short_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_low_access_states value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_shortage_buildings value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_understaffed_buildings value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_hiring_failure_buildings value = 0 }
  every_scope_state = {
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_states add = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_infrastructure_short_states add = 1 } } }
   if = { limit = { market_access < 1 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_low_access_states add = 1 } } }
   every_scope_building = {
    limit = { level > 0 }
    if = { limit = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_shortage_buildings add = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { occupancy < 1 } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_understaffed_buildings add = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { has_failed_hires = yes } root = { change_variable = { name = sed_hiring_failure_buildings add = 1 } } }
   }
  }
  sed_update_growth = yes
  sed_refresh_railway_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_construction_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_supply_candidates = yes
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
 }
}

sed_refresh_railway_candidates = {
 clear_variable_list = sed_railway_candidates
 # Counts use one primary reason per state so the breakdown adds up to the
 # deficit total instead of counting the same state under several filters.
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_deficit_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_no_railway_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_not_ready_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_railway_blocked_states value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_variable = sed_railway_request_pending
    OR = {
     NOT = { has_building = building_railway }
     b:building_railway = { level_after_queued_constructions <= level }
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_railway_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_deficit_states add = 1 } }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_railway_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_railway } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_no_railway_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     b:building_railway = {
      OR = {
       level <= 0
       occupancy < 0.8
       has_failed_hires = yes
       building_has_goods_shortage = yes
       level_after_queued_constructions > level
      }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_not_ready_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     OR = {
      NOT = { is_incorporated = yes }
      NOT = { can_construct_building = building_railway }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_railway_blocked_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = infrastructure_delta multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = {
    add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_railway_candidates target = prev }
   }
  }
 }
}

sed_run_railway_approval = {
 if = {
  limit = { sed_railway_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  start_building_construction = building_railway
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_railway_action_status value = 2 } }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}

sed_refresh_construction_candidates = {
 clear_variable_list = sed_construction_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_wood_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_iron_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_coal_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_grain_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_fabric_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_tools_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_groceries_candidates
 clear_variable_list = sed_clothes_candidates
 # Same primary-reason cascade as the railway counts. Only states that already
 # have a construction sector enter this denominator.
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_sector_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_not_ready_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_construction_blocked_states value = 0 }
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_variable = sed_construction_request_pending
    OR = {
     NOT = { has_building = building_construction_sector }
     b:building_construction_sector = { level_after_queued_constructions <= level }
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_construction_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_construction_sector }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_sector_states add = 1 } }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_construction_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     b:building_construction_sector = {
      OR = {
       level <= 0
       occupancy < 0.9
       has_failed_hires = yes
       building_has_goods_shortage = yes
       level_after_queued_constructions > level
      }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_not_ready_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = {
     OR = {
      NOT = { is_incorporated = yes }
      NOT = { can_construct_building = building_construction_sector }
     }
    }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_blocked_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_construction_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = {
   is_player = yes
   has_variable = sed_enabled
   num_queued_government_constructions >= 3
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population }
   max = 1
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = {
    add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_construction_candidates target = prev }
   }
  }
 }
}

sed_run_construction_approval = {
 if = {
  limit = { sed_construction_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels }
  }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  start_building_construction = building_construction_sector
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 1 }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_construction_action_status value = 2 } }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}

# Keep the first sample of each recorded month as the anchor. A second click in
# the same month cannot erase the baseline or pretend that a whole month passed.
sed_update_growth = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_anchor_month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_month value = var:sed_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_gdp value = var:sed_gdp }
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { var:sed_month_key > var:sed_anchor_month }
  set_variable = { name = sed_previous_month value = var:sed_anchor_month }
  set_variable = { name = sed_previous_gdp value = var:sed_anchor_gdp }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_month value = var:sed_month_key }
  set_variable = { name = sed_anchor_gdp value = var:sed_gdp }
 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth_available value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_growth_months value = 0 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_previous_gdp var:sed_previous_gdp > 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth value = { value = var:sed_gdp divide = var:sed_previous_gdp subtract = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth_months value = { value = var:sed_month_key subtract = var:sed_previous_month } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_growth_available value = 1 }
 }
}
sed_ensure_mode_default = {
 if = {
  limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual has_variable = sed_mode_assisted has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } } }
  sed_set_mode_assisted = yes
 }
}

# Country scope; the persistent marker is written before an automatic attempt.
sed_record_auto_attempt = {
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_last_attempt_month value = { value = year multiply = 12 add = month } }
 }
}

sed_refresh_supply_candidates = {
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_producer_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_pending_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_wood_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_wood_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_building = building_logging_camp b:building_logging_camp = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_wood_intent_variant = 1
      b:building_logging_camp.level > var:sed_wood_intent_level
     }
     sed_wood_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_wood_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_wood_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_logging_camp } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_logging_camp }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_wood_request_pending b:building_logging_camp = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_logging_camp = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_electric_saw_mills has_active_production_method = pm_saw_mills has_active_production_method = pm_simple_forestry } } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_logging_camp } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_wood_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_wood_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }

 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_producer_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_method_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_permission_states value = 0 }
 set_variable = { name = sed_grain_infrastructure_states value = 0 }
 clear_variable_list = sed_grain_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_building = building_wheat_farm b:building_wheat_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_rye_farm b:building_rye_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_rice_farm b:building_rice_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_maize_farm b:building_maize_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_millet_farm b:building_millet_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_intent_variant }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 1
      b:building_wheat_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 2
      b:building_rye_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 3
      b:building_rice_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 4
      b:building_maize_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_grain_intent_variant = 5
      b:building_millet_farm.level > var:sed_grain_intent_level
     }
     sed_grain_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_grain_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_grain_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_wheat_farm has_building = building_rye_farm has_building = building_rice_farm has_building = building_maize_farm has_building = building_millet_farm } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_wheat_farm }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending b:building_wheat_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_wheat_farm = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer has_active_production_method = pm_fertilization has_active_production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming has_active_production_method = pm_simple_farming has_active_production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_wheat_farm } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_rye_farm }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending b:building_rye_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { has_failed_hires = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_hiring_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_input_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_rye_farm = { NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer has_active_production_method = pm_fertilization has_active_production_method = pm_simple_farming has_active_production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_method_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { can_construct_building = building_rye_farm } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_permission_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_infrastructure_states add = 1 } }
   }
  }  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_rice_farm }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_grain_request_pending b:building_rice_farm = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_grain_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }

 clear_variable_list = sed_fabric_candidates
 every_scope_state = {
  if = {
   limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending
    NOT = { OR = { AND = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation b:building_cotton_plantation = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } AND = { has_building = building_livestock_ranch b:building_livestock_ranch = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } } }
   }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_intent_variant }
    if = {
     limit = { var:sed_fabric_intent_variant = 1
      b:building_cotton_plantation.level > var:sed_fabric_intent_level
     }
     sed_fabric_record_completed = yes
    }
    else_if = {
     limit = { var:sed_fabric_intent_variant = 2
      b:building_livestock_ranch.level > var:sed_fabric_intent_level
     }
     sed_fabric_record_completed = yes
    }
    else = { sed_fabric_record_abandoned = yes }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation has_building = building_livestock_ranch } }
   root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_producer_states add = 1 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { sed_fabric_candidate_eligible = yes } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation }
   if = {
    limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_ignored }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_ignored_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { OR = { has_variable = sed_fabric_request_pending b:building_cotton_plantation = { level_after_queued_constructions > level } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_pending_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { NOT = { is_incorporated = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_unincorporated_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { OR = { level <= 0 occupancy < 0.8 } } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_understaffed_states add = 1 } }
   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { has_failed_hires = yes } }

   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { b:building_cotton_plantation = { building_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_input_states add = 1 } }
   }

   }
   else_if = {
    limit = { infrastructure_delta < 0 }

   }
  }  else_if = {
   limit = { has_building = building_livestock_ranch }

    root = { change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_ignored_states add = 1 } }

 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled
   market = { mg:clothes ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
  ordered_scope_state = {
   limit = { sed_clothes_candidate_eligible = yes }
   order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
   max = 3
   check_range_bounds = no
   root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_clothes_candidates target = prev } }
  }
 }
}
sed_run_wood_approval = {
 if = {
  limit = { sed_wood_approval_valid = yes }
  owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_queue_levels_before value = construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels } }
  owner = { sed_record_auto_attempt = yes }
  if = {
   limit = { sed_wood_logging_camp_eligible = yes }
   # Baseline level before queuing; the monthly review compares it after the queue.
   set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_level value = b:building_logging_camp.level }
   set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intent_variant value = 1 }
   start_building_construction = building_logging_camp
  }
  owner = {
   if = {
    limit = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > var:sed_queue_levels_before }
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_intents }
     change_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_intents value = 1 } }
    prev = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_request_pending value = yes } }
   }
   else = {
    set_variable = { name = sed_wood_action_status value = 2 }
    prev = {
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
     remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
    }
   }
   remove_variable = sed_queue_levels_before
  }
 }
}
sed_wood_record_completed = {
 owner = {
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_completed }
   change_variable = { name = sed_wood_completed add = 1 }
  }
  else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_completed value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }
 }
 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_level
 remove_variable = sed_wood_intent_variant
}

  set_variable = { name = sed_wood_result_month value = sed_live_month_key }

sed_set_mode_manual = {
 sed_coord_restore = yes
 sed_restore_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_restore_wage_policy = yes
 remove_variable = sed_mode_manual remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
 remove_variable = sed_mode_automatic
 set_variable = { name = sed_mode_manual value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_schedule_auto_event = yes }
}
sed_set_mode_assisted = {
 sed_coord_restore = yes
 sed_restore_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_restore_wage_policy = yes
 remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted remove_variable = sed_mode_manual
 remove_variable = sed_mode_automatic
 set_variable = { name = sed_mode_assisted value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_schedule_auto_event = yes }
}
sed_set_mode_automatic = {
 remove_variable = sed_mode_automatic remove_variable = sed_mode_manual
 remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
 set_variable = { name = sed_mode_automatic value = yes }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_enabled NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } sed_coord_tools_available = yes } sed_coord_enable = yes }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic } sed_schedule_auto_event = yes }
}
sed_schedule_auto_event = {
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_auto_event_pending } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_event_pending value = yes }
  trigger_event = { id = sed_pulse.1 days = 23 }
 }
}
sed_auto_apply_monthly = {
 sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
 sed_apply_fiscal_policy = yes
 sed_apply_wage_policy = yes
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 2 }
 if = {
  limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  sed_coord_sync = yes
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 18 }
 }
 else_if = {
  limit = { sed_auto_executor_safe = yes }

  if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_railway_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_railway_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = infrastructure_delta multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_railway_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_wood_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_wood_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_wood_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_iron_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_iron_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_iron_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_iron_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_iron_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_coal_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_coal_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_coal_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_coal_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_coal_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_grain_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_grain_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_fabric_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_fabric_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_fabric_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_fabric_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_fabric_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_tools_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_tools_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_tools_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_tools_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_tools_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_groceries_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_groceries_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_groceries_approval = yes
   }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { any_scope_state = { sed_clothes_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 } }
   ordered_scope_state = {
    limit = { sed_clothes_candidate_eligible = yes var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 }
    order_by = { value = state_population multiply = -1 }
    max = 1
    check_range_bounds = no
    # A candidate was selected; only confirmed insertion changes this to success.
    owner = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 15 } }
    sed_run_clothes_approval = yes
   }
  }
 }
 else_if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 10 } }
 else_if = { limit = { sed_auto_month_limit_reached = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 16 } }
 else_if = { limit = { OR = { construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 construction_queue_num_queued_private_levels > 0 } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 11 } }
 else_if = { limit = { is_construction_paused = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 12 } }
 else_if = { limit = { sed_competing_builder_configured = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 13 } }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 17 } }
 else = { set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 14 } }
 # Preserve the result independently from mode controls and diagnostic refreshes.
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_status value = var:sed_auto_action_status }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_year value = year }
 set_variable = { name = sed_auto_review_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
}
sed_ignore_railway = {
 if = {
  limit = { owner = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled } sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_railway_ignored value = yes }
  owner = { sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes }
 }
}

sed_restore_ignored = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  every_scope_state = {
  remove_variable = sed_railway_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_construction_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_wood_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_iron_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_coal_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_grain_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_fabric_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_tools_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_groceries_ignored
  remove_variable = sed_clothes_ignored
  }
  sed_refresh_diagnostics = yes
 }
}
sed_refresh_national_plan = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_year value = year }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_month value = { value = month add = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 1 }
  if = { limit = { in_default = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 4 } }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = {
    AND = { net_total_income < 0 gold_reserves < { value = net_total_income multiply = -4 } }
    AND = { principal > 0 OR = { credit <= 0 principal > { value = credit multiply = 0.9 } } }
   } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_coord_reserve_drawdown_safe = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 5 } }
  else_if = { limit = { NOT = { sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes } } set_variable = { name = sed_fiscal_status value = 2 } }
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_construction
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_wood
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_iron
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_coal
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_grain
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_fabric
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_tools
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_groceries
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_1_clothes
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_construction
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_wood
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_iron
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_coal
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_grain
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_fabric
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_tools
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_groceries
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_2_clothes
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_railway
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_construction
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_wood
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_iron
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_coal
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_grain
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_fabric
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_tools
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_groceries
  clear_variable_list = sed_plan_3_clothes
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_wood value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_logging_camp } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_wood value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_wood value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:wood ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:wood ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_wood_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_wood_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_wood_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_wood_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_wood_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_wood_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_wood_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_iron value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:iron ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_iron_mine } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_iron value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_iron value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:iron ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:iron ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_iron_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_iron_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_iron_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_iron_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_iron_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_iron_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_iron_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_iron_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_coal value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:coal ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_coal_mine } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_coal value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_coal value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:coal ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders

    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = {

  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coal_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_coal_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_coal_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_coal_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_coal_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coal_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_coal_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coal_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_coal_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_grain value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:grain ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_wheat_farm has_building = building_rye_farm has_building = building_rice_farm has_building = building_maize_farm has_building = building_millet_farm } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_grain value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_grain value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:grain ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:grain ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_grain_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_grain_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_grain_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_grain_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_grain_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_grain_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_grain_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_grain_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_grain_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_fabric value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:fabric ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_cotton_plantation has_building = building_livestock_ranch } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_fabric value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_pressure_fabric value = {
   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:fabric ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:fabric ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_fabric_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_fabric_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_fabric_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_fabric_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_fabric_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_fabric_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_fabric_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_tools value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:tools ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_tooling_workshop } } }
  }

   value = 0
   market ?= { mg:tools ?= {
    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders
      divide = market_goods_buy_orders min = 0 max = 1 multiply = 100 }
    }
   } }
  } }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:tools ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_tools_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_tools_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_tools_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_tools_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_tools_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_tools_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_tools_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_tools_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }

  else = { remove_variable = sed_tools_short_months }

   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_food_industry } } }

    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }

   }

    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_groceries_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_groceries_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_groceries_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_groceries_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_groceries_short_months }
  set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_clothes value = 0 }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:clothes ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
   NOT = { any_scope_state = { OR = { has_building = building_textile_mill } } }
  }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_clothes value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_plan_missing_count add = 1 }
  }

   value = 0

    if = { limit = { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 }
     add = { value = market_goods_buy_orders subtract = market_goods_sell_orders

  } }
  if = { limit = {
   market = { mg:clothes ?= { market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } }
  }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_clothes_short_months }
    change_variable = { name = sed_clothes_short_months add = 1 }
   }
   else = { set_variable = { name = sed_clothes_short_months value = 1 } }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_clothes_short_months >= 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sed_clothes_meta_year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_clothes_meta_year value = year }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:sed_clothes_meta_year = year } }
     set_variable = { name = sed_clothes_meta_year value = year }
    }
   }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = sed_clothes_short_months }
  every_scope_state = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_railway_rank value = 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_railway_score value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { sed_railway_candidate_eligible = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_plan_railway_score value = { value = infrastructure_delta multiply = -1 max = 100 add = 100 } }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_construction_rank value = 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_construction_score value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { sed_construction_candidate_eligible = yes owner = { num_queued_government_constructions >= 3 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_plan_construction_score value = { value = 40 } }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_wood_rank value = 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_wood_score value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { sed_wood_candidate_eligible = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_plan_wood_score value = { value = owner.var:sed_plan_pressure_wood add = 90
    if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_wood_meta_year var:sed_wood_meta_year = year } } add = 25 } } }
   }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_iron_rank value = 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_plan_iron_score value = 0 }
   if = { limit = { sed_iron_candidate_eligible = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_plan_iron_score value = { value = owner.var:sed_plan_pressure_iron add = 90
    if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = sed_iron_meta_year var:sed_iron_meta_year = year } } add = 25 } } }

    owner = {
     add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_plan_3_groceries target = prev }
     change_variable = { name = sed_plan_count add = 1 }

    }
   }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_type = 10 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_plan_clothes_rank value = 3 }
    owner = {
     add_to_variable_list = { name = sed_plan_3_clothes target = prev }
     change_variable = { name = sed_plan_count add = 1 }

    }
   }
  }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_count = 0 var:sed_plan_missing_count > 0 } set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 5 } }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 0 sed_coord_fiscal_safe = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 8 } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 0 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } bureaucracy < 0 } set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 6 } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 0 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } any_scope_state = { tax_capacity_usage > tax_capacity } } set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 7 } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 0 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } any_scope_state = { sg:electricity ?= { state_goods_pricier >= 0.2 } } } set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 9 } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 } } set_variable = { name = sed_plan_goal value = 4 } }
 }
}
# Country scope. TAX_LEVELS is ordered: very_low, low, medium, high, very_high.
# Snapshot before the first change so leaving Automatic or disabling can restore.
sed_tax_policy_save = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes NOT = { has_variable = sed_tax_level_saved } }
  if = { limit = { tax_level = very_low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 1 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 2 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 4 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = very_high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 5 }
  }
 }
}

sed_apply_fiscal_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
   has_variable = sed_fiscal_status
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 2 var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 } }
   sed_tax_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { tax_level = very_low } set_tax_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = low } set_tax_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium } set_tax_level = high }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high } set_tax_level = very_high }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 1 var:sed_fiscal_status = 5 }
    gold_reserves >= { value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 12 }
    principal <= 0
    net_total_income > 0
   }
   sed_tax_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { tax_level = low } set_tax_level = very_low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium } set_tax_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high } set_tax_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = very_high } set_tax_level = high }
  }
 }
}

sed_restore_fiscal_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_tax_level_saved }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 1 } set_tax_level = very_low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 2 } set_tax_level = low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 3 } set_tax_level = medium }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 4 } set_tax_level = high }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 5 } set_tax_level = very_high }
  remove_variable = sed_tax_level_saved
 }
}
# Country scope; civilian government wages only, one step per monthly review.
sed_wage_policy_save = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes NOT = { has_variable = sed_gov_wage_saved } }
  if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 1 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 2 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = medium }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 4 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 5 }
  }
 }
}

sed_apply_wage_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
   has_variable = sed_fiscal_status
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 } }
   sed_wage_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { government_wage_level = medium } set_government_wage_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = high } set_government_wage_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_high } set_government_wage_level = high }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 1 var:sed_fiscal_status = 5 }
    gold_reserves >= { value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 12 }
    principal <= 0
    net_total_income > 0
   }
   sed_wage_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_low } set_government_wage_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = low } set_government_wage_level = medium }
  }
 }
}

sed_restore_wage_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_gov_wage_saved }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_gov_wage_saved = 1 } set_government_wage_level = very_low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_gov_wage_saved = 2 } set_government_wage_level = low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_gov_wage_saved = 3 } set_government_wage_level = medium }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_gov_wage_saved = 4 } set_government_wage_level = high }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_gov_wage_saved = 5 } set_government_wage_level = very_high }
  remove_variable = sed_gov_wage_saved
 }
}
sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_coord_active
  has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol value = var:advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury value = var:advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off value = var:advisor_setting_treasury_off }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_borrow }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_borrow value = var:advisor_setting_borrow }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_policy_saved value = yes }
 }
}

sed_coord_enable = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_advisor value = var:advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_expand_building }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_chains value = var:zw_var_expand_building }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_sectors value = var:zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_railways value = var:zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_power value = var:zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_admin value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_tax value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
  }
  if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = advisor_enabled has_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled } } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_known value = yes } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = zw_var_expand_building has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution has_variable = zw_var_added_constructions has_variable = zw_var_labor_threshold has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors_gold_reserves has_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states } } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_supply_known value = yes } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_active value = yes }
  sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
  remove_variable = sed_mode_manual
  remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
  set_variable = { name = sed_mode_automatic value = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
  sed_schedule_auto_event = yes
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
  sed_coord_sync = yes
 }
}

sed_coord_restore = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor }
   set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_advisor }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = var:sed_coord_saved_chains }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_expand_building }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = var:sed_coord_saved_sectors }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = var:sed_coord_saved_railways }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_power }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = var:sed_coord_saved_power }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = var:sed_coord_saved_admin }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = var:sed_coord_saved_tax }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol value = var:sed_coord_saved_goal_sol }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury value = var:sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_treasury_off value = var:sed_coord_saved_treasury_off }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_borrow }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_borrow value = var:sed_coord_saved_borrow }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_borrow }
  }
  remove_variable = sed_coord_active
  remove_variable = sed_coord_supply_known
  remove_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known
  remove_variable = sed_coord_executor
  remove_variable = sed_coord_advisor_policy
  remove_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_power
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_borrow
 }
}

sed_coord_sync = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual } NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted } has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  remove_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled
  remove_variable = zw_var_expand_building
  remove_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = aroai_autobuild } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 5 } }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_coord_fiscal_safe = yes NOT = { in_default = yes } is_construction_paused = no }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = var:sed_coord_saved_railways }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 2 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 6 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = var:sed_coord_saved_admin }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = 10 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 6 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 7 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = var:sed_coord_saved_tax }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 7 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 9 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_power }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = var:sed_coord_saved_power }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 8 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 3 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 6 var:sed_plan_goal = 7 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 var:sed_plan_goal = 9 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor }
 set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_advisor }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 1 }
    sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_borrow
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { principal > 0 credit > 0 principal >= { value = credit multiply = 0.5 } }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_treasury_off value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = {
     any_scope_state = { OR = { var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 } }
     AND = { var:sed_plan_goal = 5 OR = { var:sed_plan_missing_grain = 1 var:sed_plan_missing_groceries = 1 var:sed_plan_missing_clothes = 1 } }
    } }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 2 }
    }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = var:sed_coord_saved_chains }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 3 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = var:sed_coord_saved_sectors }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = 5 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 4 }
   }
  }
 }
}
